sect3.title: Paste As Single Layer In Place

indexterm.primary: Paste as Single Layer in Place

sect3.para: The Paste as Single Layer In Place command creates a new layer in the active image and pastes the clipboard contents at the exact coordinates the contents was originally copied from.
Esse recurso está disponível tanto para a área de transferência comum quanto para buffers nomeados.

sect4.title: Ativando o comando
sect4.para:
You can access this command from the main menu through
Edit Paste as Paste as Single Layer In Place .
